newsitem.title: USA: Interstate Hotels files for up to $700 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Interstate Hotels files for up to $700 mln shelf.

text.p: Interstate Hotels Co said Monday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $700 million in equity or debt securities.
It said that it intends to use net proceeds for general corporate purposes, including repayment of debt and acquisitions.

It said the filing includes approximately 4.5 million common shares held by non-employee shareholders who had been granted registration rights when they acquired their shares and 2.5 million common shares held by Milton Fine, its chairman, co-founder and largest shareholder.

It said Fine intends to donate registered shares that he owns to a charitable trust, of which his charitable foundation will be the primary beneficiary. While the trust may buy or sell Interstate stock in the future, the trust currently intends to hold the registered shares as an investment, it said.
